evidence.quoted_text: raise ReconcileRefused("repository number cap exceeded; operator partition required")
evidence.reason: Line 439 reports a repository-wide ceiling cap but tells operators to partition. Interval/window partitioning cannot reduce the repository ceiling, and number_page rejects any source ceiling above MAX_REPOSITORY_NUMBER, so each partition would fail before scanning. Keep the safety cap, but report it as a repository-wide limit and only name a supported alternate scan path.
